title: How a bench vise turns rotation into clamping force #Shorts
description:
A procedural 3D explanation of a bench vise. One turn advances the moving jaw by the screw lead. Ideal work balance: 2*pi*torque = axial_force*lead. Real clamping force depends on friction and deformation. Kinematic illustration; arrows are schematic. No AI-generated visuals.
